CVE-2026-128990.title: xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vu ...
CVE-2026-128990.description: xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in read_dataset() in src/rawtovcd.c due to an unchecked variable index. Attackers can supply a crafted ngspice .raw file that, when converted with rawtovcd, writes file-controlled heap pointers at chosen signed offsets, corrupting heap memory.

CVE-2026-128991.title: xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnera ...
CVE-2026-128991.description: xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in read_xschem_file() in src/save.c that mishandles embedded-symbol records lacking a preceding instance. Attackers can supply a crafted schematic beginning with a "[" record, causing xschem to read and dereference memory below the instance array and crash.
